note: Cross-platform export-serialization fixtures for the Phase-1 exit criterion 'the same store and scope produce byte-identical output on both platforms'. export-input-v1.json is the shared INPUT: both suites build their own domain objects from it, run their own writers, and must produce bundle-v1.json / raw-v1.csv / derived-v1.csv byte for byte. Read by apps/android/app/src/test/java/net/albayyan/badan/ExportSchemaParityTest.kt and apps/ios/Tests/ExportSchemaParityTests.swift. Neither suite may copy the records or the goldens into its own source — a copy is one more thing that can drift from the artifact it is supposed to police (same reasoning as packages/fixtures/encryption and packages/fixtures/canonicalization).
